<noinclude>
One page = one printing. Do '''not''' put empty errata sections on a card that was never errata'd.

Optional '''likeness''' — person whose face is on the card: a photographic model Decipher (or the Players Committee) cast, or the film portrayer of that character. Wiki-link the person page. Worked: [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]] → [[Shannon Baksa]]; [[Aurra Sing]] / [[Aurra Sing (AI)]] → [[Michonne Bourriague]]. Omit when the art is illustration, a starship/weapon, or a later virtual photograph that is not that person.

Optional '''image2''' — second portrait under '''image''' (same 280px width). Used for Objective 0/7 faces; omit on single-face cards.

Optional '''image2_layout''' — how to place '''image2''' when set:
* omit or '''stack''' — force stacked vertically (0 on top, 7 below); default when unset
* '''right''' — force side-by-side always (0 left, 7 right); classes '''card-portraits-row''' + '''card-rail-dual'''
* '''responsive''' — preferred Objective mode: wide viewport = side-by-side (0 left, 7 right); narrow viewport (max-width '''720px''') = stacked. Same row/dual markup plus '''card-rail-responsive''' / '''card-portraits-responsive''' so CSS media query can adapt.
